01913 Hadowram {had-o-rawm'} 或 Hadoram {had-o-rawm'}

可能源自外來語; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Hadoram 4; 4

哈多蘭 = "尊貴的榮譽"
1) 約坍的第五個兒子  (#創10:27;代上1:21|)
2) 哈馬王陀烏的兒子, 他曾擔任他父親的大使, 去向大衛王恭賀其擊敗瑣巴王哈大利謝  (#代上 18:10|)
3) 大衛, 所羅門, 羅波安時代掌管服苦的監督官; 也叫 'Adoniram' 和 'Adoram' (#代下 10:18|)
record.edic_text:
01913 Hadowram {had-o-rawm'} or Hadoram {had-o-rawm'}

probably of foreign derivation;; n pr m

AV - Hadoram 4; 4

Hadoram = "noble honour"
1) the 5th son of Joktan
2) a son of Tou, king of Hamath, was his father's ambassador to
   congratulate David on his victory over Hadarezer, king of Zobah
3) the intendant of taxes under David, Solomon, and Rehoboam; called
   also 'Adoniram' and 'Adoram'
